configurePresets.name: gcc14-cxx17
configurePresets.description: Matches ci/profiles.yaml's linux-x86_64-gcc14-cxx17-cmake-ninja profile. CI installs gcc-14/g++-14 via apt (see ci/profiles.yaml's environment note); locally this preset resolves whatever gcc-14/g++-14 actually is on PATH.

configurePresets.name: clang18-cxx17
configurePresets.description: Matches ci/profiles.yaml's linux-x86_64-clang18-cxx17-cmake-ninja profile -- the same CMake+Ninja build system as gcc14-cxx17, differing only in the producer compiler, so the producer axis can be varied without also changing the build system. CI installs clang-18 via apt (the same package abi-scan.yml's L4 replay legs already install).
